edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) The small brown teacup in the merchant's outstretched hand (the hand reaching toward the jumping man) becomes a thin, closed green book that he holds out in the same hand, in the same place. His fingers clearly grip the book. 2) The jumping man in blue now holds that same small brown teacup, empty, in his raised fist on the right side of the picture, as if he has just drunk from it. Keep the merchant's headband, his smile and the dark dried seaweed sheets he waves above his head in his other hand, the stack of seaweed on the stall, the jumping man's happy face and leaping pose, the motion lines, the thatched stalls, the bushes and the ground exactly as they are. Draw every change in the same flat cartoon style with the same thick outlines. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.

edits.fallback: 잔이 두 개 남으면 'remove the cup from the merchant's hand' 한 번 더. 잔 옮기기가 안 되면 2)를 빼고 1)만

edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) The bundle of green herbs in the kneeling red-robed man's free hand (the hand nearer the basket) becomes a large open book that he holds flat in that same hand like a tray, in the same place. The long tongs in his other hand are placing one green herb leaf onto the open pages. His fingers clearly hold the book. 2) Remove the woven basket in front of him. Fill its place by continuing the ground and the edge of the herb pile around it. 3) On the empty ground in the lower part of the picture, with no person near it, put one big closed book lying flat on the ground. Its cover has a blue and white wave pattern. One thin, old, worn brown book is tucked halfway between its pages and sticks out from the side. Keep the red-robed man's face, topknot, moustache, robe and kneeling pose, the long tongs, the big pile of herbs, the legs of the jumping man at the top left, the stool at the right edge and the ground exactly as they are. Draw every change in the same flat cartoon style with the same thick outlines. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
edits.check: 받친 책 위에 집게 끝 · 바구니 없음 · 땅의 파도무늬 책 + 끼운 낡은 책 하나 · 사람 없음 · 글자 없음
edits.fallback: 3)의 책이 작게 들어가면 같은 조각으로 3)만 'large, about as wide as the herb pile' 강조. 받친 책이 땅에 떨어지면 1)만 다시
